# Transform fields (`transform-fields`)

X, Y, W, H, angle with a reference-point grid.

Group: Media & editors. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/media';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createTransformFields` (types in `dist/web/media/transformFields.d.ts`): `.mh-transform`: a `<fieldset>` with a 3 x 3 reference-point grid (`__anchor`, native radios `__point`) and number fields for X, Y, W, H and rotation (`__field` with `__name`, `__input`, `__unit`), plus a keep-proportions toggle (`__lock`, `aria-pressed`) between W and H. X and Y are the reference point's position; resizing keeps that point still. Fields commit on Enter or blur; Up / Down step (Shift for ten); dragging a field's name scrubs its value.

```ts
export function createTransformFields(options: TransformFieldsOptions): TransformFieldsHandle;

export interface TransformFieldsOptions {
  /** Accessible name of the group ("Transform"). */
  label?: string;
  value: TransformValue;
  reference?: ReferencePoint;
  lockAspect?: boolean;
  /** Unit after X, Y, W and H (default `px`). */
  unit?: string;
  /** Arrow-key step (default 1; Shift for ten). */
  step?: number;
  /** Decimals shown (default 2, trailing zeros dropped). */
  decimals?: number;
  disabled?: boolean;
  labels?: Partial<TransformLabels>;
  onChange?: (value: TransformValue, field: TransformField) => void;
  onReferenceChange?: (reference: ReferencePoint) => void;
  onLockAspectChange?: (lockAspect: boolean) => void;
}

export interface TransformFieldsHandle {
  el: HTMLFieldSetElement;
  getValue(): TransformValue;
  setValue(value: TransformValue): void;
  setReference(reference: ReferencePoint): void;
  setDisabled(disabled: boolean): void;
}

export interface TransformLabels {
  reference: string;
  lock: string;
  x: string;
  y: string;
  width: string;
  height: string;
  angle: string;
}
```

`h` (types in `dist/web/dom.d.ts`): Creates an element: string and number attributes are set, `true` sets an empty attribute, `on*` functions become listeners.

```ts
export function h<K extends keyof HTMLElementTagNameMap>(tag: K, attrs: Attrs = {}, ...children: Child[]): HTMLElementTagNameMap[K];
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createTransformFields, h, type TransformValue } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const box = h('div', { style: 'position: absolute; border: 2px solid var(--mh-accent)' });
const canvas = h('div', { style: 'position: relative; width: 280px; height: 200px; background: var(--mh-input)' }, box);

const draw = ({ x, y, width, height, angle }: TransformValue): void => {
  Object.assign(box.style, {
    left: `${x}px`,
    top: `${y}px`,
    width: `${width}px`,
    height: `${height}px`,
    transform: `rotate(${angle}deg)`,
  });
};

const value: TransformValue = { x: 40, y: 30, width: 120, height: 80, angle: 12 };
const fields = createTransformFields({ label: 'Picture frame', value, onChange: draw });

draw(value);
document.body.append(fields.el, canvas);
```

## React example

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { TransformFields } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';
import type { ReferencePoint, TransformValue } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

export function TransformFieldsExample() {
  const [value, setValue] = useState<TransformValue>({ x: 40, y: 30, width: 120, height: 80, angle: 12 });
  const [reference, setReference] = useState<ReferencePoint>('top-left');
  const [lockAspect, setLockAspect] = useState(false);
  const { x, y, width, height, angle } = value;
  return (
    <>
      <TransformFields
        label="Picture frame"
        value={value}
        reference={reference}
        lockAspect={lockAspect}
        onChange={setValue}
        onReferenceChange={setReference}
        onLockAspectChange={setLockAspect}
      />
      <div style={{ position: 'relative', width: 280, height: 200, background: 'var(--mh-input)' }}>
        <div
          style={{ position: 'absolute', left: x, top: y, width, height, transform: `rotate(${angle}deg)`, border: '2px solid var(--mh-accent)' }}
        />
      </div>
    </>
  );
}
```
